lastCompletedStory.title: Wire model resolution into the plan-runner planner and auditor dispatches

nextStoryContext: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts's resolveAndSpawnPlanner and resolveAndSpawnAuditor (the two functions backing the readPhaseModel('planner'|'auditor', undefined, backend) call sites at ~629/~686) now call resolvePhaseModel({ phase, backend, cacheReader: codexModelsCacheReaderFn }) in place of the raw readPhaseModel read, immediately BEFORE the pre-existing codexAuthPreflight block in each function (codexAuthPreflight's own position relative to buildSpawnArgv is unchanged, per AC1 -- it still runs right before respawn-pane). A not-ok resolution returns the SAME ResolveAndSpawnResult { ok: false, reason } shape the codexAuthPreflight not-ready path already returns, firing escalateFn fire-and-forget first; the outer callers (runPlannerSpawnStep / runAuditorSpawnStep) still unconditionally map any ResolveAndSpawnResult ok:false to PlanPhaseResult's pre-existing { kind: 'codex-auth-failed', phase, reason } -- there is NO new PlanPhaseResult kind, since ResolveAndSpawnResult carries no discriminant field and the AC explicitly pinned that shape verbatim; a model-resolution failure and a codex-auth failure are therefore indistinguishable from the PlanPhaseResult kind alone (only the reason string differs) -- a future story wanting a distinct 'model-resolution-failed' PlanPhaseResult kind would need to add a discriminant to ResolveAndSpawnResult itself and update both step-wrapper mappings. A new RunPlanPhaseOptions.codexModelsCacheReaderFn?: CodexModelsCacheReader field (mirrors codexAuthCheckFn) is the injectable seam, threaded through both resolveAndSpawnPlanner/Auditor (new optional trailing parameter) and both runPlannerSpawnStep/runAuditorSpawnStep (destructured off opts, passed through positionally); when absent, resolvePhaseModel's own default parameter (readCodexModelsCache) is used. This closes out the CAM-398 model-resolution wiring epic across the 3 remaining supervisor dispatch call sites the US-004 handoff flagged as out-of-scope (plan-runner.ts's planner+auditor, review.ts's reviewer, run.ts orchestrator) -- planner+auditor are now done; review.ts's reviewer dispatch and run.ts's orchestrator dispatch (if any) remain candidates for a follow-up story if the prd.json backlog still lists them. src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts crossed its file-size ceiling (1821->1876, content.split('\n').length); raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a tracker-ref-carrying _ref entry, staged before the check:all re-run per the ratchet-gate rubric.

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story wires the already-built (US-003) resolvePhaseModel decision fn into two existing plan-runner.ts call sites (planner + auditor); no new external library or documented API surface was introduced beyond what US-001/US-002/US-003 already Step-5.5-validated (Claude Code model-config docs, openai/codex protocol source, ~/.codex/models_cache.json schema).
